carrier.contract: Each arrow returns a Result. The judges and snapshot give a refusal text, and admitChangeProof gives a Rejection with its stage. No arrow writes a file.

category.equality: Two results are equal when their values are equal. Two refusals are equal when their stage and text are equal.

abstraction.hides: The TLC record protocol, the SANY text outside the records, the state records of a trace, the progress records of a run past the deadline and the entry lines of each snapshot.
callersKnow: The last stdout line of a stop names its stage and its cause.
One stderr line names the proof contract section of the stage.
A SANY stop names the module, the line, the column and the message.
A failed run names its invariant or property and prints at most 20 steps.
A stale stop names at most 10 changed paths, the index or the ratification history.
A run past the deadline names the distinct state count and the time of its last progress record.
abstraction.deletionTest: Deleting the judges puts the TLC record protocol, the SANY text and the trace format into prove, and the fixtures can then test them only with Java. Deleting staleInputs puts the entry comparison into admitChangeProof and into each snapshot test.

alternatives.name: Leave gate rewrite paths out of the digest
alternatives.rejectedBecause: It goes against ADR 0005 D3, which binds each candidate file.

alternatives.name: A second stdout line for the section
alternatives.rejectedBecause: It changes 28 pinned stop lines, and scripts read the last stdout line.

alternatives.name: Print only the state count of a trace
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The agent cannot see the path to the broken claim.

omitted: TLC, SANY and their output text are abstracted to the bounded positive, negative and restored results.
Git and the file system are abstracted to three input kinds that can change during the runs.
The limit of 10 named paths and 20 trace steps is not modelled. Unit controls examine both limits.
The earlier authority, base, evidence and Result law parts of the model stay as they were.

bounds: Three input kinds can change during the runs: a file, the index and the ratification history. Each nonempty subset is one case.
Nine failure kinds map to five sections of the proof contract.
The authority and base cases, five validation stages and the bounded positive, negative, restored and freshness results of the earlier model.
Finite Result laws use two values, two errors and all total functions between them.

negative.original: /\ named' = IF firstFailure' = "stale" THEN changed ELSE {}
negative.defect: Dropping the changed inputs from the stale stop hides which file changed during the runs, so the agent cannot repair the stop.

limits: The finite model takes the TLC output and the Git reads as true. It does not model TLC, SANY or Git.
The model does not show that the TypeScript code refines it. The linked controls and review examine that relation.
The TLC fixtures come from tla2tools 1.7.4. Another TLC version can print other text.
Exact-head CI, review and every ordinary gate stay required.
